name: Recovery icon
description: Passive icon: a plus sign, two crossed bars, inside the grey border the Shell wears. Port of the hand-drawn i_recovery from Feelers' BootScene. The tile was venom, matching the bars the way most icons here match their own glyph; it is `$smoke.light2` now — the border ss.icon.armor wears — because Scab is the trait that finishes the Shell into Quicklime, and the two halves of a recipe have to read as the same shelf before the player is told they are. The cross wears the border's colour too, the rule every passive follows: tile and glyph are one colour, and that colour is the shelf's. The pair wore `$steel.light`, the border ss.icon.thorns still wears, until it sat too near Pulse Rate's pale slot; see ss.icon.armor.
